title: 🌱✨ When God plants greatness in you, it never looks big at the start…
paragraphs:
🌱✨ When God plants greatness in you, it never looks big at the start…
but it ALWAYS grows bigger than anyone expected.
Even in the places people overlook — GOD SEES YOU.
GOD CHOSE YOU.
GOD PLANTED SOMETHING IN YOU THAT CAN’T BE IGNORED.

Keep watering what He placed inside you.
Your harvest is coming. 🙏🔥

📖 Bible Verse:
“Do not despise these small beginnings, for the Lord rejoices to see the work begin.”
— Zechariah 4:10 (NLT)
